analysis: The zona reticularis of the adrenal cortex primarily secretes androgens, which are steroid hormones that contribute to the development of male characteristics and reproductive activity. While glucocorticoids and mineralocorticoids are produced in other layers of the adrenal cortex, the zona reticularis is specifically associated with androgen production.
